business_model.description: AppLovin describes itself as a marketing platform providing end-to-end advertising solutions. Following the 2025 sale of its Apps business, management presents the company as focused on the core advertising platform, Axon Ads Manager and the Axon AI recommendation engine, with early expansion into web-based e-commerce advertisers.
business_model.economic_model_observation: The supplied Q2 financial tables show an unusually asset-light model: Q2 2026 property purchases plus finance-lease principal were only about $5.7M against $1.924B revenue, while operating income and cash generation were very high.
business_model.key_unverified_driver: Independent advertiser ROAS, retention/cohort behavior, traffic quality, platform-policy dependence and customer concentration were not established from the supplied package.

governance.voting_agreement_observation: Adam Foroughi and Herald Chen, together with their affiliates, hold all outstanding Class B shares and voting-agreement parties collectively control 66.9% of total voting power according to the proxy ownership table.

governance.executive_ownership_guidelines: CEO and CTO 600% of base salary; other executive officers 300%; all officers and directors reported compliant.
